hints.title: Compare nodes in parallel
hints.body: At each step, the two trees should be at corresponding positions. Compare the current pair before moving to their children.

hints.title: Cover the base cases
hints.body: If both nodes are absent, this part matches. If exactly one is absent, the shapes differ. If both exist but their values differ, the trees differ.

hints.title: Recurse on both sides
hints.body: The current pair matches only when the left subtrees match and the right subtrees match.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
function same(a, b):
    if a is null and b is null: return true
    if a is null or b is null: return false
    if a.value != b.value: return false
    return same(a.left, b.left) and same(a.right, b.right)
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
